title: Orange recording model artifacts (version 2)
description: recording_session.json model_artifacts: for every distinct engine that ran (keyed by engine sha256, the same value as models.<serial>.<detect|pose>.runtime.engine_sha256 in the snapshot) the files that say what the engine is, copied byte for byte into <recording folder>/models/<engine_sha256>/ and declared with path (relative to the recording folder), size, sha256 and the digest the file should have. The files: the engine manifest; the Palette canonical ONNX model manifest the engine manifest binds (source.canonical_manifest), for detect and pose; the pose model input contract a pose engine binds (source.input_contract); and, for INT8 engines, the calibration record and the trtexec calibration cache (build.int8_calibration). A file is listed when the engine manifest names it. expected_sha256 is the digest recorded where the file is named (the snapshot's engine_manifest.sha256 for the engine manifest, the engine manifest's sha256 for the others), empty when none is recorded; a copy whose bytes differ is kept and marked digest_mismatch. models_keys lists the cameras and tasks that used the engine. Engine status present = every listed file copied with the expected digest; partial = some file absent, not copied or mismatched; absent = the engine manifest was not present on the rig (nothing copied). The skeleton is not copied: the snapshot's pose block embeds it. v2 adds the canonical_onnx_manifest and pose_model_input_contract roles, expected_sha256 and the digest_mismatch status to v1. Written by materialize_model_artifacts (src/session/model_artifacts.cpp) at finalization; closed.

source_path.description: Where Orange read the file on the host.

sha256.description: Digest of the copied bytes; empty when nothing was copied.

expected_sha256.description: The digest recorded where the file is named; empty when none is recorded.
